title.zh: 有界各向异性试探参数优化

summary: Select an optional Latin-hypercube starting point, run a SciPy least-squares or minimize search through a caller trial evaluator, and retain the best recorded trial and optimizer status.

identity.relation: bounded fit parameters and trial residual relation to the lowest recorded chi-squared parameter record
identity.direction: initial_params, bounds, method and trial_evaluator -> best_parameters, chi2, residual_vector, equilibrium and log/status
identity.definition: In bounds or fit_keys order, extract x0 and lower/upper arrays. If n_initial_samples is supplied, evaluate each injected LHS sample in listed order and start SciPy from the lowest-chi2 LHS sample. SciPy least_squares uses the trial residual vector; minimize uses its squared norm. Every trial is logged and a strictly lower chi2 updates the best record. A caught exception during SciPy selection/execution records its message and evaluates the start once as fallback.
identity.model: bounded numerical parameter search over a caller-defined anisotropic equilibrium trial relation
identity.geometry: none internally; caller trial evaluator owns equilibrium geometry
identity.coordinates: fit_keys order or bounds insertion order defines the optimizer vector; other initial_params keys are copied unchanged into each trial
identity.boundary: Bounds are passed to SciPy; this function itself does not prove finite, increasing bounds or clamp the fallback trial. The optional LHS sampler owns its own bound validation.
assumptions: trial_evaluator(params=...) returns chi2, residuals, equilibrium and failure_reason, with residuals suitable for the selected SciPy routine.
The caller selects scientifically meaningful fit parameters and ranges; numerical success alone does not establish a valid physical inversion.

inputs.name: initial_params
inputs.description: Initial full parameter mapping; non-fitted keys are retained in trials.
inputs.constraints: Contains all selected keys; fitted values must be acceptable to the selected SciPy method and bounds.

inputs.name: bounds
inputs.description: Bounds for fitted parameters and default key order.
inputs.constraints: Selected keys must exist with pairs accepted by SciPy; the implementation does not independently validate finite increasing intervals.

inputs.name: method
inputs.constraints: 'least_squares' or 'minimize'; any other value enters the caught-exception fallback.

inputs.name: trial_evaluator
inputs.description: Caller-owned per-parameter residual and equilibrium evaluation.
inputs.constraints: Returns chi2, residuals, equilibrium and failure_reason keys; errors before the SciPy try block may propagate.

inputs.name: fit_keys
inputs.description: Optional ordered subset of parameters to fit.
inputs.constraints: Omitted selects all bounds keys; uniqueness/nonemptiness are not separately enforced.

inputs.name: lhs_sampler
inputs.description: Optional caller-supplied LHS callable for choosing the starting point.
inputs.constraints: Required when n_initial_samples is non-null; each sample should provide fitted keys.

inputs.name: n_initial_samples
inputs.description: Optional sample count passed as int to lhs_sampler.
inputs.constraints: A non-null value triggers LHS before SciPy; sampler controls positivity validation and an empty sample list raises before fallback.

inputs.name: seed
inputs.description: Optional seed forwarded to lhs_sampler only.
inputs.constraints: Has no effect when n_initial_samples is null.

outputs.name: best_parameters
outputs.description: Full parameter mapping from the strictly lowest-chi2 recorded trial.
outputs.constraints: Defaults to initial_params until a trial improves infinity; LHS and optimizer trials compete.

outputs.name: chi2
outputs.constraints: Usually finite when trial_evaluator provides finite chi2; not independently checked here.

outputs.name: residual_vector
outputs.description: Residual vector of the best recorded trial.
outputs.constraints: Converted from best trial residuals; an unusable trial contract can produce conversion errors or nonfinite values.

outputs.name: converged
outputs.description: True only when SciPy reports success and the best retained equilibrium exists and reports converged.
outputs.constraints: No residual threshold or separate physical validity check is applied.

outputs.name: equilibrium
outputs.description: Best trial's caller-owned equilibrium, or null if no trial improved the initial record.
outputs.constraints: May be nonconverged even when chi2 is best.

outputs.name: evaluation_log
outputs.description: Ordered parameter, chi2, failure_reason and source entries for each evaluated trial.
outputs.constraints: LHS entries precede optimizer entries; source is latin_hypercube or optimizer.

outputs.name: failure_reason
outputs.description: Text of an exception caught during SciPy selection/execution, otherwise null.
outputs.constraints: May be null even when converged=False; outer graph may supply a clearer reason.

outputs.name: optimizer_summary
outputs.description: Selected SciPy result's method, success, status, message and nfev; null on caught exception.
outputs.constraints: Does not contain the complete SciPy result object.

preconditions: The caller supplies a trial evaluator with consistent residual length and meaningful parameter bounds.
Any injected LHS sampler returns at least one valid sample when requested.
supported: SciPy bounded least_squares or minimize with an optional sampled starting point and full evaluation log.
A source-compatible fallback trial when method selection or SciPy execution raises.
excluded: Global optimality, guaranteed convergence, covariance estimation or automatic physical correctness of a caller model.
Independent validation of parameter bounds, fitted-key uniqueness or every trial's returned structure.

failure_semantics.invalid_input: Missing keys, malformed bounds, nonconvertible values, missing lhs_sampler when samples are requested, malformed/empty sampler output or trial failure during LHS can raise before the SciPy try block. Unsupported method is caught inside that block, producing a fallback trial and failure_reason if that trial succeeds.
failure_semantics.runtime_failure: An exception during SciPy selection/execution is caught, its text recorded, and evaluate(x0) is called once; an exception in this fallback evaluation propagates. No rollback of already logged trials occurs.
failure_semantics.nonconvergence: Returns converged=False if SciPy reports failure, no SciPy result exists, or the best equilibrium is absent/nonconverged; this Operator does not synthesize failure_reason for every such case.
failure_semantics.partial_results: Caught SciPy errors return the best retained trial plus fallback log, not a partial SciPy result. Errors before/within fallback return no mapping.

provenance.lineage_summary: Maintained SciRel optimizer mapped to saved Pleiades L1 direct-inversion material and direct tests; historical candidate labels do not imply expert recognition.
source_kinds: saved L1 Operator contract and implementation

python.signature: optimize_anisotropic_parameters(*, initial_params, bounds, method, trial_evaluator, fit_keys=None, lhs_sampler=None, n_initial_samples=None, seed=None)

example.description: A one-parameter caller trial is minimized while a fixed extra parameter is retained.
example.code:
import numpy as np
from scirel.inference import optimize_anisotropic_parameters
def trial(*, params):
    residuals = np.array([params['x'] - 3.0])
    return {'chi2': float(residuals @ residuals), 'residuals': residuals, 'equilibrium': {'converged': True}, 'failure_reason': None}
r = optimize_anisotropic_parameters(initial_params={'x': 0.0, 'fixed': 7.0}, bounds={'x': (-5.0, 5.0)}, fit_keys=['x'], method='least_squares', trial_evaluator=trial)
assert abs(r['best_parameters']['x'] - 3.0) < 1e-6
assert r['best_parameters']['fixed'] == 7.0 and r['converged']
assert r['chi2'] == min(e['chi2'] for e in r['evaluation_log'])
example.expected: Least squares finds x near 3 while keeping fixed=7, and the best recorded trial is converged.

scope: One-dimensional least-squares recovery and preservation of unfitted keys.
LHS-first log order and minimum-chi2 start selection.
Unknown-method fallback records a trial without claiming convergence.
verification.evidence_ceiling: Direct tests establish selected SciPy and fallback paths with simple synthetic residuals; they do not prove global optimum, robustness for arbitrary caller evaluators or scientific suitability of fitted parameters.
known_limitations: Bounds and LHS sampler records are largely delegated to SciPy or the injected sampler, and some malformed inputs fail before fallback.
Best chi2 and optimizer success can refer to different trials; converged additionally checks the best equilibrium.
Public distribution licensing and SciRel expert recognition remain pending.
